item_name: Rothco R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) Flag Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco’s R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) Flag Patch symbolizes support and remembrance for deployed service personnel.
description: Rothco’s R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) Flag Patch symbolizes support and remembrance for deployed service personnel. Measuring 3 ½” X 2”, the military patch features a hooked back so you can attach it to a variety of gear, including tactical caps and military backpacks. Constructed with durable high-quality material, the RED patch features a black background, red stripes, and white “Remember Everyone Deployed” lettering and stars.
